headline: Jaden's Best Cards
title: Jaden's Best Cards in Yu-Gi-Oh | Top 3 Explained
video_script: Here are Jaden Yuki's best cards. Number 3: Elemental HERO Flame Wingman, his signature card, burning your opponent for the attack of the monster it destroys. Number 2: Elemental HERO Neos, the heart of his Neo-Spacian Contact Fusion deck. Number 1: and Winged Kuriboh, the card Yugi gave him, which stops battle damage for a turn when destroyed. Whose deck should I cover next? Comment below!

joke: Jaden's deck has more plot armour than my whole collection.
